defaults.act_binding_not_an_idea: Acts bound to a chapter were treated as bound to no idea, as in 0.1
defaults.act_without_boundary: Acts without a starting point were treated as the book's first act, as in 0.1
defaults.ambiguous_history_template_field: Template fields with the same name in snapshot history: only the first was kept
defaults.ambiguous_template_field: Fields with the same name in a category template: only the one 0.1 listed first was kept
defaults.category_layout_incomplete: Category layouts that were incomplete were treated as automatic, as in 0.1
defaults.chapter_in_group_dropped: Idea groups on chapters, which 0.1 did not use, were not brought over
defaults.chapter_without_book_order: Chapters without a book order were put first, as 0.1 reads them (book order 0)
defaults.comment_target_missing: Comments on things deleted for good were kept and show without a place
defaults.duplicate_act_boundary: Acts with the same starting point were imported as they were, as in 0.1
defaults.duplicate_history_value_for_template_fie: In snapshot history, of several values under one field name, the first went into the field and the rest were kept as key-values
defaults.duplicate_value_for_template_field: Of several values under one field name, the first went into the field and the rest were kept as the entry's own key-values
defaults.element_missing_category: Elements without a category (or whose category was deleted) went into “未分类” under “要素”, as in 0.1
defaults.entity_link_dropped: Links that point to no entry were removed; the words stay
defaults.fallback: Imported as it was; recorded in the import record
defaults.history_preview_missing: Snapshot history without a preview could not be checked out and was skipped
defaults.history_preview_unreadable: Snapshot history whose preview could not be read could not be checked out and was skipped
defaults.idea_group_missing: Ideas whose group no longer exists went to the top of ideas, as in 0.1
defaults.idea_has_legacy_book_order: Book orders on ideas, which 0.1 did not use, were not brought over
defaults.incompatible_history_node_status: Writing statuses in snapshot history that did not match their kind were not replayed
defaults.incompatible_source_node_status: Writing statuses that did not match their kind became that kind's default status, as 0.1 showed them
defaults.membership_target_missing: Storyline links to a chapter or storyline that no longer exists had nowhere to go and were not brought over
defaults.membership_target_trashed: Chapters' places in deleted storylines were kept; they come back when the storyline is restored
defaults.multiple_primary_memberships: Where a chapter had several main storylines, the last one was kept as main, as in 0.1; the others remain storylines
defaults.orphan_history_source: Snapshot history of things deleted for good was skipped
defaults.pin_binding_missing_idea: Time pins whose idea is gone or in Recently Deleted were kept, no longer bound
defaults.plot_grid_position_key_regenerated: Broken position keys in the plot planner were made again in 0.1's order
defaults.source_tree_cycle: Groups and material folders that were each other's parent were cut at the one with the smallest id and put at the top level
defaults.source_tree_missing_parent: Groups and material folders whose parent no longer exists went to the top level, as in 0.1
defaults.unknown_node_kind: Chapters of a kind 0.1 did not know were imported as ideas, as in 0.1
defaults.unreadable_history_metadata: Titles and other fields in snapshot history that could not be read were not replayed; the text versions were kept
defaults.unreadable_source_aliases: Alias lists that could not be fully read kept only what could be read
defaults.unreadable_source_kv_projection: Field orders that could not be read were sorted by when the fields were created
defaults.unreadable_source_template: Text templates that could not be read were not made into templates; the original stays in the book's catalog
defaults.unsupported_table_cell_content: Lists, headings and the like in table cells kept only their text
defaults.unsupported_table_cell_mark: Formatting in table cells that the new version doesn't know was removed; the words stay
defaults.writing_day_duplicate: Several writing-day rows for the same device and day were added together, as in 0.1's heatmap
defaults.writing_day_invalid: Writing days whose date or device could not be read had nowhere to go and were not brought over

lossy.act_binding_kept_existing_placement: Ideas bound to an act already had a place in the default timeline view; it was kept and not replaced by the act's span
lossy.act_binding_shared_idea_split: One idea was bound to several acts: the earliest act keeps the idea, and each of the others got a new entry of the same name under “幕”
lossy.align_unsupported: Justified text was imported as left-aligned
lossy.built_in_relation_type_dropped: The built-in “Association” relation type was not imported
lossy.comment_action_dropped: Actions of the retired {{product}} on comments (accept / reject) are no longer imported
lossy.comment_priority_dropped: Comment priorities were not imported (comments no longer have priorities)
lossy.entity_link_same_target_overlap: Where two links to the same thing covered different spans of the same text, the later one was kept
lossy.entity_link_to_asset_kept_as_text: Links in the text to image or PDF materials that have no file had nothing to point to and became plain text; each is listed below
lossy.formatting_kept_as_text: Formatting in comments, patches or material descriptions was imported as plain text; the original is in the import record
lossy.heading_or_indent_clamped: Heading levels or indents out of range were brought within H1–H3 and 0–8
lossy.list_item_extra_paragraph: A list item held several paragraphs; in the new version each paragraph is an item
lossy.material_embed_dropped: Embedded materials whose material could not be found were imported as empty paragraphs
lossy.ordered_list_start: The starting number of numbered lists was not kept
lossy.relation_comment_end_dropped: Relations with a comment at one end were not imported
lossy.relation_image_end_dropped: Relations with an image at one end were not imported
lossy.relation_missing_entry_dropped: Relations with an end that no longer exists were not imported
lossy.relation_other_end_dropped: Relations with another kind of material at one end were not imported
lossy.relation_patch_end_dropped: Relations with a patch at one end were not imported
lossy.relation_pdf_end_dropped: Relations with a PDF at one end were not imported
lossy.relation_self_end_dropped: Relations whose two ends are the same thing were not imported
lossy.relation_todo_end_dropped: Relations with a to-do at one end were not imported
lossy.table_cell_marks: Text formatting in table cells was not kept (cells in the new version hold plain text)
lossy.table_cell_paragraphs_joined: Several paragraphs in a table cell were joined into one, with line breaks between them
lossy.table_cell_span: Merged table cells and column widths were not kept
lossy.table_header_cell: Table header cells were imported as ordinary cells
lossy.task_status_follows_tick: Where a checklist item's to-do status disagreed with its tick, the tick was followed; each is listed below
lossy.task_todo_link_replaced_by_projection: Checklist items no longer link to a separate 0.1 to-do; each keeps its own tick and becomes a checklist comment
lossy.template_unreadable: Templates that could not be read were not imported (their old fields were kept as they were)
lossy.unknown_block: Paragraph types the new version doesn't know were imported as plain paragraphs
lossy.unknown_inline: Inline objects the new version doesn't know were removed from the text and recorded as they were in the import record
lossy.unknown_mark: Text formatting the new version doesn't know: the text was kept, the formatting removed

mirrorV5.intro: Each project has a Markdown folder. Edits to prose and fields in another editor merge into Drifting after you save.
mirrorV5.offWarning: Drifting merges pending edits before turning the folder off. Existing files stay where they are. You can turn it back on in Local Data.
mirrorV5.identity: The drifting-id does not match this entry and prose module.
mirrorV5.lineage: The entry or prose has been restored, reshaped, or deleted. The file’s edits could not be merged.
mirrorV5.owned: Another Drifting installation owns this folder.
mirrorV5.unsafePath: Drifting could not safely access this path in the project folder.
mirrorV5.occupied: A file already occupies this path.
mirrorV5.duplicate: Two files have the same drifting-id.
mirrorV5.moved: Renaming and moving files do not sync in this version.
mirrorV5.readOnly: The read-only properties were restored from the project.
mirrorV5.malformedTable: The table could not be read. The original table is still in Drifting.
mirrorV5.unknownImage: The image points outside the project’s file library. The line was imported as text.
mirrorV5.fieldConflict: A field could not be merged: it was also edited in Drifting, or its value could not be read. Drifting kept its value and saved a copy of the file.
mirrorV5.keyCollision: A property at the top has the same name as a newly added field. Drifting will not write this file until one of them is renamed or removed.
